svg.title: One conversation, five memories
svg.desc: The same three sessions run through five memory systems. In March the user states a diet, an allergy and a cuisine; in July they change the diet, move, and name two guests with their own needs; in September they ask for a booking. Textual memory rewrote its profile with the old diet as 'previously' (2 LLM calls to write; all six needs in the prompt). Mem0 added the new fact and kept the old one live (2 calls; both diets in the prompt). Graphiti closed the old fact and opened the new one (36 calls; its search returned only the old diet and missed gluten and the area). Letta's agent overwrote the line in place (5 extra calls inside its turns; all six). Honcho retired the old fact and a conclusion drawn from it (6 calls; all six).
svg.text: The same three sessions, run through five memory systems: what each one did when the user changed their mind in July,
what writing cost, and what reached the prompt in September.
